mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT starget.target_id, starget.resolved_ip ip, starget.port port, css.tls_version tlsVersion, css.is_accepted accepted FROM scan_task stask RIGHT JOIN scan_target starget ON stask.task_id = starget.task_id RIGHT JOIN cipher_suite_support css ON starget.target_id = css.target_id WHERE stask.task_id = #{taskId} LIMIT #{offset}, #{size};

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT starget.target_id, starget.resolved_ip, starget.port, css.tls_version, css.is_accepted FROM scan_task stask RIGHT JOIN scan_target starget ON stask.task_id = starget.task_id RIGHT JOIN cipher_suite_support css ON starget.target_id = css.target_id WHERE stask.task_id = #{taskId} ) AS subquery
